note: Symbolic box codes for the STANDARD return. The structure follows the official return text of the public VAT code list (column Momsangivelse: Salgsmoms, Købsmoms, Moms af varekøb i udlandet (både EU og lande uden for EU), Moms af ydelseskøb i udlandet med omvendt betalingspligt, Rubrik A varer og ydelser, Rubrik B varer, B oplysninger der ikke skal indberettes til EU-salg uden moms, B ydelser, Rubrik C) and must still be reconciled with the current TastSelv form before RELEASED. Danish labels and the derived total are app content (app/filing/dk-vat-return-layout.json). Energy taxes are not in v0.2. EC_LIST has no boxes: its rows are per partner, country and category (08, 6.4). The OSS return is not in v0.2
